in_sanskrit.name: रक्षा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The word Raksha is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Raks' meaning 'to protect'. The name signifies the one who provides protection and shields from harm. It is also the name of a deity in Hinduism who is the god of protection.

in_hindi.name: रक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रक्षा (Rakshā) is a Hindi word meaning protection, shield. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Raks', meaning 'to protect'. The name signifies the one who provides protection and shields from harm.

in_tamil.name: ரக்ஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Rakshā is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Raks', meaning 'to protect'. It signifies the one who provides protection and shields from harm. The Tamil meaning of Rakshā is 'valai', which means protection.

in_telugu.name: రక్షా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Rakshā is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Raks', meaning 'to protect'. It signifies the one who provides protection and shields from harm. The Telugu meaning of Rakshā is 'puddējjadu', which means protection.

in_marathi.name: Raksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who protects, guardian, savior

in_bengali.name: Raksha
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raksha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who protects, guardian, savior
